name: Koç University Graduate Scholarships
amount: Tuition waiver + monthly stipend for thesis MS/PhD (60,000 TL/month from Oct 2026 per one Koç page)
dlText: Expected: early ~15 Feb 2027, regular ~15 May 2027 (based on Fall 2026 dates)

countryNotes.PK: HEC scholars can get 100% PhD tuition through the Koç–HEC partnership (apply to both).

fields: Sciences, engineering (incl. CS), social sciences, humanities
note: Admitted thesis-based MS/PhD students are considered automatically. A good option if you're already in Türkiye.

name: Bilkent University Graduate Scholarships
amount: Tuition waiver, often with a monthly stipend (about 90% of graduate students are supported)
dlText: Expected ~1 Jun 2027 (late ~1 Jul), based on Fall 2026 Engineering & Science dates
note: Apply through stars.bilkent.edu.tr/gradapp. Stipend levels are set yearly. A good option if you're already in Türkiye.
